img_886.description: Image cut into shuffled tiles. Small figures (nymphs) with red head-dresses sitting in blue-and-white striped barrels or tubs, holding eight-pointed stars; lines of unknown script along curved bands. Fragments of a larger uncoloured four-legged animal (legs, hooves, rounded body) standing over green wavy ground; one tile shows a green plant sprig.
img_886.central_figure: A pale, uncoloured four-legged hoofed animal on green ground, possibly a ram or goat
img_886.sign_reason: Hoofed quadruped without strong colour on green ground; no clear horns visible, so ram vs bull vs goat is uncertain

img_743.description: Shuffled tiles. Nude and partly clothed women drawn in brown ink, some wearing blue robes or head-cloths, one holding a star; curved text bands. No animal or object fragment clearly identifiable as the central emblem.
img_743.central_figure: Not identifiable; only parts of surrounding human figures in blue clothing visible
img_743.sign_reason: No distinctive animal or object visible among the tiles

img_593.description: Shuffled tiles. Many nude women in brown outline with stars, curved text bands, a little blue and green colour. One tile shows a dark crossbow with a figure's arm, partly painted over.
img_593.sign_reason: Clear crossbow fragment; the archer is the standard emblem of Sagittarius

img_768.description: Shuffled tiles. Several scaly fish drawn in brown ink with blue touches, on a blue wavy line (water); striped/hatched bands like rays or a frame; stars and curved text.
img_768.central_figure: Two (or more) fish, with water lines
img_768.sign_reason: Repeated scaly fish with fins and tails over water

img_801.description: Shuffled tiles. Nude women in faint brown ink with stars and curved text, some red dots. Dark green/olive patches: an animal head or body and a green curled loop like a tail, plus a small dark green creature.
img_801.central_figure: A dark green creature with a curled tail, possibly a scorpion or lizard-like animal
img_801.sign_reason: Dark green animal with a looped curling tail; identification of the creature is uncertain because of shuffling

img_725.description: Shuffled tiles. Clothed women in blue and green dresses, some with head-dresses, others nude, holding stars; curved text bands. One tile shows a larger blue robe at a bigger scale than the surrounding figures.
img_725.central_figure: Possibly a large standing woman in a blue robe
img_725.sign_reason: A larger-scale draped blue robe suggests a central female figure (maiden); weak evidence

img_986.description: Shuffled tiles, somewhat faded. Nude women with stars, curved text bands. Two tiles show a red crustacean with claws and legs, and green-coloured parts nearby.
img_986.central_figure: A red crayfish/crab-like creature with claws
img_986.sign_reason: Red clawed crustacean with many legs, the emblem of Cancer

img_878.description: Shuffled tiles. Women's heads, a figure in a woven basket/barrel, stars, curved text, a blue wavy line with scalloped ground. A green-bodied animal with ridged curved horns and a goat-like face; green foliage.
img_878.central_figure: A green goat-like animal with curved ridged horns
img_878.sign_reason: Goat face with backswept ridged horns; could also be a ram (Aries)

img_279.description: Shuffled tiles. Nymphs with red-hatched clothing in towers/barrels with arched openings and woven tubs, stars, curved text. One tile shows a horned animal head in red with green colour beside it.
img_279.central_figure: A red horned animal, apparently a bull
img_279.sign_reason: Red animal head with two upright horns, typical bull

img_247.description: Shuffled tiles. Nude women in tubs holding stars, curved text bands. Large red-coloured animal: one tile with a horned head, another with a red body and legs, green ground strip.
img_247.sign_reason: Red quadruped body with horned head

img_541.description: Shuffled tiles. Many nude women in brown ink, stars, curved text. Fragments of a horizontal beam and an upright post with blue colour, and round blue-lined pans or bowls.
img_541.central_figure: A balance (pair of scales) with beam, post and pans
img_541.sign_reason: Horizontal beam on a central post with hanging pans, i.e. scales

img_408.description: Shuffled tiles, faded and grainy. Faint brown-ink figures, curved text, a red dot. Fragments of feathered or furry parts with blue speckles and a hooked beak-like head.
img_408.central_figure: Unclear; possibly a bird-like or maned animal
img_408.sign_reason: Fragments too faint and ambiguous to identify the emblem

recognise_source: Yes: the style (nude nymphs in tubs holding stars, concentric text rings in an unknown script, crossbow archer, fish pair) matches the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408).
